description: The pie chart illustrates the original distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset, with proportions based on the number of utterances. The chart is divided into six distinct slices, each representing a different emotion. Reading clockwise from the top left, the categories are Frustration in light blue (25.1%), Neutral in purple (23.1%), Happiness in medium blue (8.1%), Excitement in red (14.1%), Sadness in orange (14.7%), and Anger in yellow (14.9%). Percentage values are displayed directly inside each slice, while the corresponding text labels are positioned outside the pie chart adjacent to their respective segments. The chart does not include a separate legend, nor are any slices visually emphasized through explosion, offset, or bolding. Visually, the segments do not appear to be arranged in a strict ascending or descending order by size.
